description: This file manages caching and retrieval of model endpoint data, specifically for the 'openrouter' provider, using in-memory cache and file system cache. It includes functions to get, read, write, and flush model endpoint data, and references external modules for file handling, path operations, and specific project utilities.

methods.name: writeModelEndpoints
methods.description: Asynchronously writes model endpoint data to a JSON file in the cache directory.

methods.name: readModelEndpoints
methods.description: Asynchronously reads model endpoint data from a JSON file in the cache directory, returning undefined if not found.

methods.name: getModelEndpoints
methods.description: Retrieves model endpoint data, using cache if available, or fetching from openrouter provider and updating cache.

methods.name: flushModelProviders
methods.description: Deletes cached model endpoint data for a specific router and model ID.
